name: Isoconversional lines (OFW / KAS) for α = 0.1 … 0.9
use_case: One straight line per conversion level from runs at three or more heating rates; the slopes give Eα.

data_roles.alpha per heating rate: one conversion column per run (the heating rate is read from the header)

origin_hint: Origin: scatter + Linear Fit per conversion level (Analysis > Fitting > Linear Fit).
calculations: T at each α by interpolation
OFW: ln β vs 1/T, slope = −1.052 E/R
label_policy: labels/peak names only from user files or user confirmation
